Hero.title: Screened construction crews and skilled tradespeople for contractors in Belgium
Hero.subtitle: No stacks of CVs — just tradespeople and construction crews who can start on site straight away. We work exclusively on medium-sized and large projects for professional (main) contractors and construction companies; we do not take on small jobs.

quality.title: Personal Vetting
quality.description: We speak to every candidate in person and check every reference. You only get people we would hire ourselves.

speed.title: 14-Day Trial Week
speed.description: Not sure about the fit? Use our trial week. The first 14 days are there to see whether the chemistry is really right.

network.title: Anonymous Screening
network.description: We protect the privacy of our tradespeople. You assess skills and experience; contact details follow once there is a match.

reliability.title: No Headaches
reliability.description: We handle the administration (through our payroll partners) for individual tradespeople and construction crews alike, so you can focus on the build.

HowItWorks.title: How we work
HowItWorks.subtitle: Two sides of the same agreement: you request a crew, crews sign up — we do the selection.

candidates.title: For crews and self-employed tradespeople
candidates.description: Work is done by crews, not by individual applicants: sign up once and we introduce you to sites that fit.

step1.title: Sign up
step1.description: Fill in the registration form for subcontractors: specialism, how your crew is made up, documents and the rate you have in mind. Free, no account needed.

step2.title: Personal screening
step2.description: We call you, speak to every tradesperson and check the documents. If something is missing, we tell you honestly what still has to be arranged.

step3.title: One site, 14-day trial
step3.description: We introduce you to one contractor. You agree the rate and start date directly with them; we take care of A1 posting declarations, Limosa (the Belgian notification for posted workers) and Checkinatwork (the Belgian site check-in register). The first 14 days are a trial period.

employers.title: For contractors
employers.description: Quality over quantity, in three steps.

step1.title: Define the need
step1.description: Tell us exactly which expertise and which headcount your project requires.

step2.title: One selected proposal
step2.description: We put forward one screened crew or specialist we have spoken to in person — not a stack of CVs.

step3.title: Start and evaluation
step3.description: The crew starts with a 14-day trial period. Our invoice only follows once that period has been completed successfully.

AboutPage.title: Personal & Constructive
AboutPage.subtitle: Your direct line to craftsmanship in construction.
AboutPage.story_p1: Constructief is not a large office full of anonymous consultants. I am your personal partner, and I speak the language of construction. After years in the sector I know that a good match is more than a few lines on a CV.
AboutPage.story_p2: My approach is simple: I speak to every tradesperson, I check every reference, and I personally stand behind the quality I deliver. We have a direct pool of available bricklayers, formwork carpenters, crane operators, electricians and welders. No empty promises, but honest advice and solid results you can build on. Alongside individual self-employed specialists, we match complete, fully legal construction crews to main contractors. Our fee is a finder's fee paid by the client — we take no percentage of the rate you agree with the crew.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy & Trust
PrivacyPage.intro: Trust is the foundation of construction. At Constructief we go further than the law requires: we protect your identity and your data as if they were our own.

collection.title: 1. Personal Screening
collection.content: We only collect what is needed to introduce you: experience, skills and references. Your contact details stay with us until there is a mutual fit.

usage.title: 2. Targeted Matching
usage.content: Your information is used to find the perfect match. No automated systems: human judgement decides whether a project suits you.

sharing.title: 3. Anonymous Process
sharing.content: Your privacy comes first. We introduce you to partners anonymously. Only when you and the partner agree to meet do we share the details that are needed.

security.title: 4. Secure Storage
security.content: Your data is stored securely and is accessible only to me, as your personal point of contact.

rights.title: 5. You Decide
rights.content: You decide. Want to change your data or remove it from our network? One short message is enough for us to arrange it straight away.

CitiesSeo.antwerpen: Antwerp is not only the largest port city but also a hub for large-scale infrastructure and industrial construction. Demand for specialised tradespeople for the chemical cluster and the port expansions is extremely high here.
CitiesSeo.gent: The historic city of Ghent combines carefully executed renovation projects with modern urban development around the docks. There is strong demand for restoration experts and tradespeople with experience in sustainable, modern timber construction and renovation.
CitiesSeo.brussel: As the capital of Europe, Brussels is characterised by large office complexes and complex inner-city renovations. It calls for tradespeople who can handle tight spaces, strict noise regulations and multilingual sites.
CitiesSeo.brugge: In Bruges the focus is firmly on heritage and historic preservation. The strict building regulations in the city centre call for subcontractors with specific expertise in traditional building techniques and detailed finishing.
CitiesSeo.leuven: With its growing population and university institutions, Leuven is seeing a boom in the construction of laboratories, student housing and modern care homes. Innovation and energy-efficient building are central here.
CitiesSeo.mechelen: Located centrally between Antwerp and Brussels, Mechelen is undergoing major urban renewal. Large residential projects and the development around the station call for efficient, versatile construction teams.
CitiesSeo.hasselt: Hasselt and the wider Limburg region are front-runners in circular construction and new residential districts. There is a great need for groundworkers and tradespeople for large infrastructure works across the province.
CitiesSeo.luik: Liège's transformation from an old industrial city into a modern logistics hub is generating a great deal of construction activity. Welders, industrial electricians and steelworkers are especially sought after here.
CitiesSeo.aalst: Located in the Dender region, Aalst is seeing strong growth in both apartment building and industrial projects along the motorway. Reliable bricklayers and formwork carpenters are essential for these rapid developments.
CitiesSeo.kortrijk: Kortrijk is known for its innovative entrepreneurship and design. The construction of modern business premises and architectural showpieces attracts specialised joiners and finishers.
CitiesSeo.sint-niklaas: In the heart of the Waasland region, Sint-Niklaas is busy redeveloping old industrial sites into green residential districts. Renewable-energy installers and HVAC technicians are crucial here.
CitiesSeo.oostende: On the coast, construction in Ostend calls for specific materials that withstand salty sea air and strong winds. Specialists in façade renovation and high-quality roofing are kept very busy here.
CitiesSeo.genk: Genk is transforming former mine sites into innovation campuses. This calls for a mix of industrial builders and specialists in repurposing large, complex structures.
CitiesSeo.roeselare: As the beating heart of the West Flemish food and agricultural industry, Roeselare has a constant need for hall builders, concrete workers and refrigeration technicians.
CitiesSeo.amsterdam: Amsterdam combines complex foundation repairs in the historic canal ring with large-scale new-build on the Zuidas. A shortage of space and strict logistics rules make building here a real challenge.
CitiesSeo.rotterdam: Known for its modern skyline and Europe's largest port, Rotterdam is the city of high-rise and innovative architecture. Rebar fixers, crane operators and welders are indispensable here.
CitiesSeo.den-haag: As the political capital, The Hague requires high-quality finishing for ministries, embassies and luxury residences in Scheveningen. Discretion and top-quality plasterers and painters are essential here.
CitiesSeo.utrecht: Utrecht's central location and rapid population growth are driving enormous infrastructure works around the station and in Leidsche Rijn. There is a constant call for road builders and all-round construction workers.
CitiesSeo.eindhoven: Eindhoven, the heart of the Brainport region, is seeing an explosion of high-tech facilities and housing for expatriates. Installers specialising in cleanrooms and smart home automation find plenty of work here.
CitiesSeo.tilburg: Tilburg is the logistics hotspot of the Netherlands. The rapid construction of huge distribution centres along the motorways calls for efficient steel builders, roofers and floor layers.
CitiesSeo.almere: As the fastest-growing city on reclaimed land, Almere is the testing ground for new building styles and sustainable districts. Timber-frame construction and serial housing are the order of the day here.
CitiesSeo.groningen: Alongside regular construction, Groningen places a heavy emphasis on earthquake-resistant building and on strengthening existing structures. Specialists in foundation engineering and structural reinforcement are badly needed.
CitiesSeo.breda: Breda is investing heavily in renewing its station area and in making its Burgundian city centre more sustainable. Tradespeople who can apply modern techniques with respect for history are worth their weight in gold here.
CitiesSeo.nijmegen: The oldest city in the Netherlands is growing fast across the river Waal. Large civil engineering projects and new sustainable districts require an army of groundworkers and building services technicians.
CitiesSeo.apeldoorn: Located on the Veluwe, Apeldoorn focuses on green and nature-inclusive construction. There is high demand for ecological builders and experts in sustainable finishing.
CitiesSeo.haarlem: Its proximity to Amsterdam makes Haarlem extremely popular. The focus is on high-quality renovation, splitting listed buildings into separate units and making the most of every square metre.
CitiesSeo.enschede: The transformation from a former textile stronghold into a technology region is generating innovative construction projects in Enschede. There is a strong need for tradespeople in commercial construction and building services.
CitiesSeo.arnhem: Arnhem positions itself as an energy city. Projects around the power grid, hydrogen and sustainable district heating call for highly qualified welders and electricians.
CitiesSeo.amersfoort: The historic centre combined with the huge growth district of Vathorst makes Amersfoort a dynamic city. Here contractors look for reliable bricklayers, carpenters and roofers for serial housing.
CitiesSeo.zaandam: Characterised by Zaan timber construction, Zaandam calls for tradespeople who have mastered that specific style and traditional woodworking, combined with modern insulation standards.
CitiesSeo.s-hertogenbosch: Den Bosch is busy developing the Paleiskwartier district and making the city resilient to flooding. Civil engineering contractors and water-management experts are crucial here.
CitiesSeo.zwolle: As a hub in the east of the country, Zwolle is growing fast. There is a desperate shortage of hands, especially in road building and the delivery of climate-neutral commercial buildings.
CitiesSeo.zoetermeer: This former growth centre is now due for a large-scale sustainability upgrade of the housing stock built in the 1970s and 1980s. Insulation experts and façade workers are highly sought after.
CitiesSeo.leiden: With Leiden Bio Science Park as its engine, there is a constant stream of complex laboratory construction. This demands absolute precision from installers and finishing crews.
CitiesSeo.maastricht: Construction in the hilly, historic city of Maastricht brings unique logistical challenges. Tradespeople with experience in marlstone (mergel) construction and complex restoration are indispensable here.
CitiesSeo.dordrecht: As the oldest city in Holland, located on the water, maritime construction and dyke reinforcement play a major role in Dordrecht. There is plenty of work for specialists in water engineering and foundation repair.

WorkerFaq.title: Frequently asked questions from tradespeople
WorkerFaq.subtitle: What you need to know before you start.

items.q: Do I need documents like A1 or Limosa?
items.a: We handle all the legal obligations, including A1 certificates and Limosa notifications. You don't have to worry about the paperwork — we make sure you work 100% legally.
We don't provide housing. We do help you find a place to stay close to the site, and we discuss what it costs up front.

items.q: When and how do I get paid?
items.a: Payment runs directly between you (or your crew) and the contractor you work for — not through us. We agree the rate and the terms before you start and put them in writing, so you know where you stand up front.
Once you're approved, you can usually be on site within a few days to a week, depending on your trade.

items.q: Do I have to register in Belgium?
items.a: No. We guide you through the whole process. Only your experience and skills count — we take care of the rest.

content.heading: Become a subcontractor at Constructief
content.intro: Constructief is a Belgian company that supplies screened construction crews to general contractors in Belgium and the Netherlands. We work with crews from Eastern Europe: bricklayers, concrete workers, plasterers, façade workers, roofers and finishers. Registration is free — you pay nothing; our fee is paid by the client.
benefits: Direct assignments from general contractors — no intermediaries.
We arrange A1, Limosa and Checkinatwork.
The rate is known before you start on site.
One fixed point of contact who speaks your language.
Work over longer periods, not for a single day.
docs: A1 — for workers from the EU.
For non-EU workers: legal residence status and the right to work.
Limosa notification (we arrange it for you).
IBAN bank account number for payment.
process: You fill in the form below (± 2 minutes).
We contact you on WhatsApp and discuss experience, crew and rate.
We check the documents and look for a suitable site.
You start on site; the first two weeks are a trial period.
If it works, we continue on a permanent basis.

faq.q: Do I have to pay to register?
faq.a: No. Registration and matching are free. Our fee is paid by the client, not by you.

faq.q: What are A1 and Limosa, and who arranges them?
faq.a: A1 proves that you pay social contributions in your EU country. Limosa is the mandatory notification for work in Belgium. We tell you which documents are needed and help with Limosa.

faq.q: Can I work without knowing the language?
faq.a: Yes. On site, basic Dutch or English is enough, and you are in contact with a supervisor who speaks your language.
The rate depends on your speciality and the site. You know the rate before you start.

faq.q: I work alone — am I eligible?
faq.a: Yes. We place both individual specialists and full crews with a crew leader.

faq.q: Where can I live during the work?
faq.a: We help you find accommodation near the site. We discuss the costs in advance.

beton.antwerpen: In Antwerp, port buildings, logistics halls and urban apartment construction drive demand for formwork carpenters, rebar fixers and concrete pouring crews. As a construction subcontractor you get personally screened tradespeople, with A1, Limosa and Checkinatwork fully arranged.
beton.gent: In Ghent, urban renewal, apartment projects and works around the quays call for experienced formwork carpenters and rebar fixers who can work on compact sites. You test the proposed crew for 14 days and receive no stacks of CVs.
beton.leuven: In Leuven, student housing, care buildings and research environments create demand for precise structural crews for foundations, walls and floor slabs. For posting construction staff we select every tradesperson personally and link our fee to the result.
beton.brussel: In Brussels, apartment construction, office conversions and underground structures boost demand for formwork carpenters, rebar fixers and pouring crews. We supply pre-screened crews to the construction subcontractor, with the required A1 documents, Limosa notification and Checkinatwork in order.

dak.antwerpen: In Antwerp, renovation of terraced houses, apartment buildings and industrial premises in the port area drives demand for experienced roofers. Constructief supplies a personally screened roofing subcontractor for flat and pitched roofs, with A1, Limosa and Checkinatwork arranged.
dak.gent: Ghent combines renovation in the historic centre with new housing projects on the edge of the city. That calls for crews with experience in pitched roofs, insulation and renovation work on tight sites.
dak.leuven: In Leuven, demand comes mainly from renovating student housing, terraced houses and apartment buildings. You get no stacks of CVs, but a personally screened roofing subcontractor you can test for 14 days first.
dak.brussel: Brussels has many renovations of apartment buildings, townhouses and flat roofs, often on sites with limited access. If you are looking for a roofing crew, Constructief gives you a pre-screened crew with all the required paperwork fully arranged.

gevel.antwerpen: In Antwerp, apartment renovations, warehouses and logistics buildings drive demand for bricklayers, pointers and external insulation installers. As a construction subcontractor we supply personally screened tradespeople, with A1, Limosa and Checkinatwork fully arranged.
gevel.gent: In Ghent, renovating historic buildings and new housing projects calls for tradespeople for traditional masonry, pointing and insulation systems. Through posting construction staff you get a suitable crew without stacks of CVs, with a trial period of 14 days.
gevel.leuven: In Leuven, renovation of student housing, apartment buildings and compact urban projects drives demand for bricklayers and insulation installers. We speak to every tradesperson personally and link our fee to the result.
gevel.brussel: In Brussels, renovating offices and apartment buildings and making older properties more sustainable call for crews for masonry, repair and external insulation. We supply pre-screened construction workers and arrange A1, Limosa and Checkinatwork in full.

interieur.antwerpen: Renovating townhouses, apartments and retail premises in Antwerp calls for tradespeople for gyproc, ceilings, interior joinery and bespoke work. As a construction subcontractor we supply personally screened crews, with A1, Limosa and Checkinatwork fully arranged.
interieur.gent: In Ghent, renovating terraced houses, student rooms and historic buildings drives demand for experienced installers of walls, ceilings, doors and fitted furniture. You get no stacks of CVs, but a proposed crew you assess on site during a 14-day trial period.
interieur.leuven: The Leuven market is shaped by renovation of homes, student housing, offices and care buildings. For posting construction staff we select tradespeople who carry out gyproc, interior joinery and finishing precisely, with a fee linked to the result.
interieur.brussel: In Brussels, renovating apartments, offices and retail premises often calls for multilingual crews for walls, ceilings, doors and bespoke work. We deploy crews from Poland, Ukraine and Romania who can work in several languages, with all legal documents in order in advance.

renovatie.antwerpen: Renewing townhouses, apartments and retail premises in Antwerp calls for all-round finishers, plasterers and tilers. Constructief supplies personally screened crews, with A1, Limosa and Checkinatwork fully arranged.
renovatie.gent: In Ghent, modernising terraced houses, student housing and old commercial premises drives demand for tradespeople for demolition, structural repair and interior finishing. You test the proposed crew for 14 days and our fee is linked to the result.
renovatie.leuven: In Leuven, renewing townhouses, apartment buildings and student properties calls for compact crews who can work in occupied buildings with difficult access. We speak to every tradesperson personally, so you receive no stacks of CVs.
renovatie.brussel: In Brussels, upgrading apartment buildings, offices and older townhouses drives demand for multilingual crews for full refurbishment and finishing. If you are looking for a renovation crew, Constructief gives you a personally screened crew with all required documents arranged.

ruwbouw.antwerpen: In Antwerp, urban apartment construction, renovation and logistics projects around the port drive demand for steel fixers, formwork carpenters and bricklayers. We speak to every tradesperson personally and arrange A1, Limosa and Checkinatwork in full.
ruwbouw.gent: In Ghent, urban renewal, apartment construction and the repurposing of industrial buildings call for experienced crews for foundations, concrete structures and masonry. You test the selected tradespeople on site for 14 days first.
ruwbouw.leuven: In Leuven, demand comes mainly from compact housing projects, care buildings and buildings for education and research. We supply screened steel fixers, formwork carpenters and bricklayers without stacks of CVs, with a fee linked to the result.
ruwbouw.brussel: In Brussels, apartment renovations, office conversions and mixed urban projects create a need for flexible crews for concrete and shell works. We select every tradesperson personally and take care of all required documents for a compliant deployment.
